summary: The Tech Buzz reported that Monday.com joined a group of major tech companies explicitly citing artificial intelligence as a driver for workforce reductions, describing the work-management platform as blaming automation for job cuts.
evidenceQuote: The work management platform became the 21st major tech company in 2026 to explicitly cite artificial intelligence as a driver for workforce reductions, according to a TechCrunch analysis.
notes: The source frames the layoff as explicitly AI-cited but does not provide a confirmed headcount, so layoffsCount remains null.

sources.name: The Tech Buzz
sources.quote: Work management platform becomes latest in growing wave of companies blaming automation for job cuts.
